files.description: Shop purchases (900 rows): purchase_id (whole number), subscriber_id (refers to subscribers.csv; most subscribers have several purchases), store_city (city name; the same city is written with different capitals and extra spaces, e.g. "lisbon" and "LISBON"; about 2% empty), quantity (whole number), spend (two decimals).

task_text: Write one report line per store city (surrounding spaces removed, each word capitalised; purchases without a city are left out) in the form 'Lisbon: 152 purchases', ordered alphabetically by city. Index the table by the tidied city and loop over the groups of that index level to produce the lines. `result` should be the list of lines.
intended_computation: Return 6 strings '<City>: <n> purchases', one per tidied city, sorted alphabetically by city name.

acceptable_variants.notes: the order is by the city part of each line (the city name before ': '); the order among entries of one city is free; any standard alphabetical collation of the city names is accepted

predicted_direction.reason: on 3.x the group keys of a one-element level list are 1-tuples, so the lines read "('Lisbon',): ..."

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
